name: Kelso-Gross Family LLC

nadir.desc: The property consists of a large primary building with a gray shingle roof and multiple roof planes|A curved paved driveway leads from the street to the front of the building and garage|Dense mature trees surround the structure on all sides|A patio or deck area is visible at the rear|Lawn and landscaped beds sit along the driveway|Neighboring buildings and a tennis court are present on the same street.

alpha.desc: The front of the building faces the street with a curved paved driveway leading to garage doors and the main entry|The structure has a gray shingle roof with multiple gables|Dense trees line both sides of the driveway and screen much of the front elevation|A small lawn and landscaped island sit beside the drive.

bravo.desc: The left side of the building is heavily screened by mature trees|The gray shingle roof and rear patio area are partially visible through the canopy|The paved driveway is visible near the front|Tree coverage limits clear sightlines along this elevation.

charlie.desc: The rear of the building shows the back roof planes, a patio or deck area, and dense trees close to the structure|The curved paved driveway is visible at the front|Vegetation surrounds the rear yard and may limit movement and visibility behind the building.

delta.desc: The right side of the building shows the side elevation, roof planes, and a patio or deck area at the rear|Dense trees line this side of the lot|The paved driveway is visible toward the front|Lawn and landscaping are present near the drive.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a curved paved driveway from NW Strath Way to the front of the building and garage. The site sits in a dense residential neighborhood near a golf course and a tennis court. Mature trees surround the building on all sides and may limit visibility from the street and movement around the structure. The driveway provides turnaround space at the front. Rear and side access appear limited by vegetation and neighboring lots.
clarifications: Does the driveway terminate at the garage, or is there vehicle access around the building? Are there gates or barriers on the driveway? Is there a walkway from the rear patio to the street that is not visible through the trees? How close is tree coverage to the roof for movement around all sides? Is the tennis court on this parcel or on an adjacent property?
